subject: Text in Shiny apps stuck in italics

messages.author: 4e85ff38339d8219
messages.subject: Text in Shiny apps stuck in italics
parts:
Hi all,

I opened my computer today and discovered that, when I run them in RStudio, every piece of text in every app I ran was in italics -- in headers, select-input menus, and even data tables. Nothing in any of the apps is supposed to be (nor ever has been) italicized. The error occurs exclusively when I run the apps locally in RStudio; everything looks normal when I run it locally in a browser or when I go to the links where they are deployed.

Nothing in the files has changed since yesterday (when they were fully functional) and my RStudio is fully updated. I updated R and all the relevant packages but it did not make a difference. Any idea what's going on or how to fix it?

Thanks!
